name: n8n_edit_workflow
description: Update an existing n8n workflow by ID. Only fields supplied in the call are changed. Gated: requires user confirmation unless auto-mode is on.
expected_effect: Modifies an existing workflow in the connected n8n instance. Affected fields can be any combination of name, nodes, connections, and the active flag. Not automatically reversible — the prior definition is overwritten.

parameters.name: workflow_id
parameters.description: ID of the workflow to edit
